originalQuestion: E677 implies E255 on finite carriers
equivalentQuestion: E9321 implies E203 on finite carriers

e9321.fixedPointReformulation: The pairwise disjoint fixed-point sets of the row permutations cover the carrier iff E203 holds.

e255DivisionImages.sourceBijectivity: Neither side is forced by E255, even on finite carriers.
e255DivisionImages.rightImage: Right quasigroups satisfying E255; right division preserves E255.
e255DivisionImages.leftImage: Left quasigroups for which every x admits a,b with x*a=x, a*b=x, b*x=x.
e255DivisionImages.warning: E203 describes the transferred E255 condition within E677/E9321, not the full left image of E255.
e255DivisionImages.counterexample: Addition on ZMod 3 satisfies E255; its left division y-x fails E203.
